definitions.gloss: center, middle, right in the middle
definitions.explanation: The exact center point of something. The {真|ま}ん emphasizes that it's the true/exact center.

examples.japanese: テーブルの{真|ま}ん{中|なか}に{花|はな}を{置|お}きました。
examples.english: I placed flowers in the middle of the table.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}に{立|た}ってください。
examples.english: Please stand in the center of the room.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}を{歩|ある}かないでください。
examples.english: Please don't walk in the middle of the road.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}に{立|た}ってください。
examples.english: Please stand in the center of the photo.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}ん{中|なか}の{席|せき}が{空|あ}いていますから、そこに{座|すわ}りましょう。
examples.english: The middle seat is empty, so let's sit there.

notes:
{真|ま}ん{中|なか} emphasizes the exact center. The {真|ま}ん prefix means 'true/exact' and intensifies {中|なか}.

CONTRAST WITH {中|なか}:
- {中|なか}: inside, middle (general)
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}: right in the center, dead center (exact)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}に: in the center of ~
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}の{席|せき}: the middle seat
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}あたり: around the middle

OTHER {真|ま}ん〜 WORDS:
The {真|ま}ん prefix appears in other words emphasizing 'exactly/right':
- {真|ま}ん{前|まえ}: right in front
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}い: perfectly round
- {真|ま}っ{直|す}ぐ: straight ahead
- {真|ま}っ{白|しろ}: pure white
